why: The heuristic's rung on the game as it now stands. search-40, the strongest one-move weights and the table's second bot, was searched on content 95a78999 and held on 6198d349 (#358, no rung). Since then the content moved to f3e8a42d: Greedy breaks a purchase tie with its dice (ADR 0113), Wraithguard +5, Vital Surge 1 and Whirlwind 8, Fury 6 (tune 30), the capstones (Titan sunder 10, Apex +5, Archmage shared and stacking, ADR 0114), and the hand-tuned Bite, Ambush, Latch, Revitalize and Renewal Burst. Greedy also reads a shared passive once for each living creature of the side, so what a weight buys has moved under search-40. This rung starts from search-40 and plays every candidate as the heuristic against Greedy and against search-40 itself, so that a set cannot climb by learning Greedy alone, on 200 seeds drawn fresh from 6000000 to 6900000 (heuristic-rung-seeds-200.json); no run has used that window, nor the hold-out window just above its largest seed. 6 rounds of 12, seed 0; the heuristic's evaluations are fast enough for 200 seeds and both opponents. What would make it a rung: a set that beats search-40 against both Greedy and search-40 on the unseen seeds the hold-out replays.
